name: Section heading
description: Section intro: uppercase subtitle and display title (style display, tag h2) on the left, a short description bottom-aligned on the right. One markup for every heading style; each style is a data-style value.
useWhen: Opening a page section or a group of sections
Top of an inner page that needs a title and a one-line summary
avoidWhen: Top of a landing page with actions and media: use Hero
A heading inside a section: use es-section-header

examples.title: Split (style 1)
examples.description: Subtitle and title left, description bottom-aligned right. Stacks below 1024px.

examples.title: Surfaces
examples.description: data-surface sets the band; text remaps on its own.

examples.title: Title only
examples.description: Any part may be left out; a lone column spans the full width.
